name: dotnet-flow-tools
description: Translate .NET code into easy-to-read business domain documentation.

dotnetFlow.cliBuild.description: Relative path of built CLI executable inside the extension

dotnetFlow.model.markdownDescription: Combined provider and model in the form `provider | modelId` (e.g., `built-in | gpt-4o`, `bedrock | us.anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0`). Prefer using the 'Dotnet Flow Tools: Select AI Model' command to choose from available models.
dotnetFlow.model.patternErrorMessage: Expected format: provider | modelId (e.g., built-in | gpt-4o)

dotnetFlow.awsProfile.description: AWS profile to use for Bedrock provider

dotnetFlow.awsRegion.description: AWS region to use for Bedrock provider

dotnetFlow.businessContext.description: Business domain context to improve documentation examples. Describe your specific business domain, product types, or industry context to generate more relevant examples.

dotnetFlow.defaultSolution.description: Preferred solution path or filename for this workspace folder when multiple .sln files exist. May be absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

dotnetFlow.debug.savePrompts.description: Save LLM prompts and responses to .debug/prompts/ for debugging (overwrites on each run)

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:cli && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:cli:osx-x64 && pnpm run build:cli:osx-arm64 && pnpm run build:cli:win
scripts.build:cli:osx-x64: cd cli && dotnet publish -c Release -r osx-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bin/osx-x64
scripts.build:cli:osx-arm64: cd cli && dotnet publish -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bin/osx-arm64
scripts.build:cli:win: cd cli && dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bin/win-x64
